headline: Nvidia's share price briefly set a new record on Friday 2 October, then ended the day just below its May high as investors returned after a two-month slump.
score_reason: Lowered from 8: the headline says a record, but the shares closed just below the May high and the $6 trillion mark was not reached.
importance_line: It suggests investors are returning to AI stocks after months of doubt about AI spending, which matters to people whose savings sit in funds that hold Nvidia, but the shares closed just short of their record.
summary: Bloomberg reports that Nvidia shares reached a record price during trading on Friday, the first since May, but closed up 1.3% and just short of that record. The stock has risen 23% since a low in late July, after a two-month selloff that erased more than $1 trillion of its value, and Nvidia is now worth about $5.6 trillion.
